# pcd_networking_qos_bandwidth_limit_rule (Resource)

Manages a bandwidth-limit rule on a Neutron QoS policy in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_qos_policy" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-qos"
}

resource "pcd_networking_qos_bandwidth_limit_rule" "example" {
  qos_policy_id  = pcd_networking_qos_policy.example.id
  max_kbps       = 3000
  max_burst_kbps = 300
  direction      = "egress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_kbps` (Number) The maximum rate in kbps.
- `qos_policy_id` (String) The QoS policy this rule belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `direction` (String) The traffic direction: egress (default) or ingress.
- `max_burst_kbps` (Number) The maximum burst size in kilobits.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_qos_bandwidth_limit_rule.example <qos_policy_id>/<rule_id>
```
